escena: SCENE: a still from a modern, cinematic corporate comedy sketch, photorealistic. In the same brand-new contemporary meeting room on a high floor of a modern office tower in Santiago de Chile: floor-to-ceiling frameless glass walls, a long pale oak meeting table with a thin matte black steel base, modern upholstered chairs in warm grey, a large frameless wall display, linear recessed LED ceiling lights, polished concrete floor, one sculptural green plant; through the glass the Santiago skyline and the Andes. Current-generation hardware only (thin aluminum laptops, frameless screens), clean surfaces; nothing dated, no paper stacks, no books, no old monitors, nothing worn. Paula sits at the table staring into the void, utterly defeated, in medium shot, 50mm f/2.8. Absurd comic signs that WEEKS have passed, as props on an otherwise immaculate modern room: real dusty cobwebs stretched between her laptop screen and the table, her sculptural plant now dried out and drooping, a precarious tower of fifteen empty paper coffee cups, a few crumpled sticky notes, a single new grey streak in her hair. Far behind her, small and out of focus, Antonio — fresh, impeccable, unchanged — keeps calmly typing on his laptop. Antonio wears the Efeonce corporate uniform: the deep navy bomber jacket of the kit, CLOSED, with its embroidered emblem on the left chest exactly as in the references, over a plain white t-shirt. GEOGRAPHY (critical, continuity): ONE single long pale oak meeting table runs from the foreground straight back toward the floor-to-ceiling window wall. The camera is at the interior end of that table, looking along it toward the windows. Paula sits on the LEFT long side of this same table in the foreground. Antonio sits on the RIGHT long side of the SAME table, at its far end next to the windows, about four meters behind her, facing diagonally toward her side; the table surface visibly continues without any gap from Paula's place to Antonio's laptop. There is NO second table, NO parallel table and NO seam or gap in the tabletop: Paula's place and Antonio's place are on one continuous slab, its right edge one straight unbroken line from the foreground to Antonio. Both laptops are current-generation ultra-thin space-grey aluminum laptops with minimal bezels. Paula's drink is a kraft paper coffee cup with a black lid. Light: soft, flat, cool overcast daylight from the windows under a flat grey sky, neutral and slightly grey, muted colors, calm and corporate — a modern office on a dull day, never fluorescent, never dirty.
